text: Ko onon yo gomɗimɓe Alla e Nulaaɗo Makko on, wata on wa'u wa heereɓe ɓen ka naafiqiiɓe, hiɓe wi'ana siɗɓe maɓɓe ɓen : "Si ɓen setike ɗaɓɓere arsike, maa ɓe laatii haɓooɓe ; ɓe maayi maa ɓe waraa, hara nun hiɓe ka amen ɓe roŋki yaltude e hare nden, ɓe maayataano maa ɓe waree. Alla no Waɗii nden fiɓnde ɗon ka ɓerɗe maɓɓe fii no ɓe ɓeydora nimse e suno. Ko Alla Tan woni Wuurniroowo Wara e Muuyɗe Makko ; roŋkugol yahde ka hare haɗataa Muuyɗe Makko ɗen. Alla ko Reŋtuɗo kon ko golloton, huunde suuɗaaki Mo e ɗum, O Yoɓitoyay on ɗum.
